title: Add rerun CSV PlanOnly mode
summary: Resolved FR-042 by adding a distinct no-write CSV rerun PlanOnly mode while preserving the existing evidence-writing DryRun behavior.
reason: Operators need a true planning mode that can inspect rerun CSV/config/source rows without creating LocalBase rerun manifests, temp config, stage roots, park roots, output roots, or media mutations.
behavior_before: Invoke-RerunCsv exposed DryRun only; DryRun intentionally wrote rerun manifests and created rerun staging/park directories before exiting. Backend/WebView launch surfaces could request dry-run or live start only.
behavior_after: Invoke-RerunCsv accepts PlanOnly as a mutually exclusive no-write mode that resolves rows and logs the plan before any rerun manifest, temp config, stage, park, output, or source-media writes. Backend launch plans, Local API preflight/contracts, and WebView launch controls carry plan_only separately from dry_run.
rollback_plan: Revert this packet's touched files to restore the previous dry-run/live-only CSV rerun launch surface. Existing DryRun manifest behavior remains unchanged by the rollback because this slice adds a new mutually exclusive PlanOnly path.
